clue.text: Quick with double helping of pork?

indicators.note: double asks for the piece of pork to be served twice over, side by side

parts.note: a chop is a cut of pork served as one helping

explanation.surface: A diner orders a hurried second serving of pork.
explanation.definitionFit: The exclamation urging someone to hurry is a synonym for fast or quickly done.

clue.text: French writer found American river first!

indicators.note: first tells us the river is placed ahead of the American piece

parts.note: the Cam is the river flowing through Cambridge
US is the abbreviation for American, as in US citizen

explanation.surface: A French author discovers an American river before anyone else.
explanation.definitionFit: Albert Camus was a celebrated French novelist and essayist, author of The Outsider.

clue.text: Boy committing crime in the house

indicators.note: in places the crime inside the word for the boy

parts.note: a page is a boy servant or attendant
arson is the crime of deliberately setting fire to property

explanation.surface: A lad is caught committing an offence inside a home.
explanation.walkthrough: 'committing' is only a link; the house belongs to a clergyman.
explanation.definitionFit: A vicarage-style dwelling provided by the church for its clergyman is a kind of residence.

clue.text: Short stocking on lady giving shout of praise

indicators.note: short means the word for the stocking is cut off before its final letter

parts.note: hose are stockings or tights
Anna is a woman's name, so a lady

explanation.surface: A woman wearing a cropped stocking calls out in praise.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Short' drops the last letter of HOSE to leave HOS; in a down clue 'on' simply sets ANNA below it.
explanation.definitionFit: It is the liturgical cry of adoration sung in church, as at Palm Sunday.

clue.text: An off-putting habit

parts.note: off-putting seems to mean unpleasant, but here it means habitually putting things off till later

explanation.definitionFit: Delaying tasks again and again is literally a habit of putting off, i.e. postponing.

clue.text: Sprinkle spice

definitions.meaning: to scatter small amounts over something, as in dotting a text with quotations
the hot seasoning ground from peppercorns

explanation.definitionFit: As a verb it means to scatter liberally over; as a noun it is the familiar hot condiment.

clue.text: Lead about additional vegetable for flavouring

indicators.note: about means the symbol for lead wraps around the word for additional

parts.note: Pb is the chemical symbol for lead
other means additional, as in other reasons

explanation.surface: A guide brings around an extra vegetable to season a dish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Lead' reads as a verb but is the metal, symbol PB; 'about' puts OTHER between P and B.
explanation.definitionFit: A pot-herb is a leafy plant grown to be cooked or used as seasoning in the pot.

clue.text: Reflective authors I have followed

indicators.note: followed says the contraction for I have comes after the authors

parts.note: pens can stand for writers, as in hired pens
I've is the contraction of I have

explanation.surface: A fan of certain writers looks back thoughtfully on having followed them.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone thoughtful and lost in quiet contemplation is described as dreamily meditative.

clue.text: Banished ambassador who was in the red

indicators.note: was in means the envoy sits inside the colour word

parts.note: taken as written
a legate is an envoy, especially one representing the Pope

explanation.surface: An envoy whose embassy ran up debts has been sent away.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in the red' looks like the idiom for being in debt, which makes the ambassador seem bankrupt; it is the container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Sent down or exiled, as a football club demoted to a lower division.

clue.text: During the tremor, risked having a dance

indicators.note: during says the answer lies within the run of letters of these two words

explanation.surface: Someone braved an earthquake to keep on dancing.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a traditional English folk dance performed with bells and sticks.

clue.text: Possible preference, a newcomer

parts.note: an option is a choice or preference
L is a learner, shown on L-plates, so a newcomer

explanation.surface: A new arrival might be someone's first choice.
explanation.definitionFit: Something left to choice, not compulsory, is merely possible rather than required.

clue.text: Vessel crossing bar?

parts.note: reads as a ship clearing a harbour sandbar, but also a large drinking glass handed across a pub counter

explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a sailing ship and a tall sherry or beer glass served over a counter.

clue.text: Making a mistake not starting the fish

indicators.note: not starting means the fish's name loses its opening letter

parts.note: the herring is a common North Atlantic fish

explanation.surface: Someone gets it wrong by failing to get the fish cooking.
explanation.definitionFit: Going astray or committing an error is the present participle of a verb meaning to blunder.

clue.text: No means to include Anno Domini in these modern times

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: to include means the word for means takes the era abbreviation inside

parts.note: ways are means, as in ways and means
AD abbreviates Anno Domini, the Christian-era dating

explanation.surface: A complaint that present-day dating no longer bothers with AD.
explanation.walkthrough: 'means' reads as a verb, but it is the noun the abbreviation goes into.
explanation.definitionFit: It is an adverb meaning at the present time, these days.

clue.text: Could be spotting Henry entering place of entertainment

indicators.note: entering means the abbreviation for Henry goes into the word spotting
could be hints the letters may form something else once rearranged

parts.note: H is the symbol for the henry, the unit of inductance

explanation.surface: Seeing a man called Henry going into a club or venue.
explanation.walkthrough: 'entering' puts H into SPOTTING, and 'Could be' rearranges all nine letters.
explanation.definitionFit: A club or bar open late for evening amusement is a venue for going out.

clue.text: He is in finest order

indicators.note: is in means the pronoun sits inside the word for finest

parts.note: best means finest

explanation.surface: A man is in his best condition.
explanation.walkthrough: 'order' looks like the anagram signal for 'He is', but it is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A command or bidding, as in done at the king's request, is an instruction.

clue.text: Driver's halo?

parts.note: a halo is a ring of light round the head, and a driver has a lamp at the car's front

explanation.definitionFit: A car's front lamp is a light at the head of the vehicle, as a halo is light at a saint's head.

clue.text: Work to rule

parts.note: reads as industrial action, but means doing the job of ruling over people

explanation.definitionFit: To control and direct a nation or body is to exercise authority over it.

clue.text: Senior cleric is covering the meat

parts.note: Ven. is short for Venerable, the title of an archdeacon
taken as written
on means placed over or covering, as a lid on a pot

explanation.surface: A high-ranking churchman is shielding the joint of meat.
explanation.definitionFit: It is the flesh of deer, eaten as game.

clue.text: Blissful state that's not applicable going round topless South Ayrshire resort

indicators.note: going round means the abbreviation surrounds the trimmed resort

parts.note: N/A is the form-filling abbreviation for not applicable

indicators.note: topless means the resort name loses its first letter

parts.note: Girvan is a seaside town in South Ayrshire, Scotland

explanation.surface: Bliss may not apply to a stripped-down Scottish seaside visit.
explanation.walkthrough: Girvan is a seaside town on the South Ayrshire coast of Scotland; 'topless' removes its first letter and 'going round' wraps the abbreviation for not applicable around what is left.
explanation.definitionFit: In Buddhism it is the final state of release and perfect peace.

clue.text: Could be rare find beyond one end of the visible spectrum

definitions.text: beyond one end of the visible spectrum

indicators.note: could be suggests these letters could be rearranged into another word

explanation.surface: A scientist hopes for an unusual discovery past the edge of what we see.
explanation.definitionFit: Radiation with wavelengths longer than red light lies just past the red edge of sight.

clue.text: Stockings angler uses?

definitions.meaning: open-mesh hosiery worn on the legs
a fisherman might use a mesh for catching his catch

explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a style of mesh hosiery and the literal net a fisherman casts.

clue.text: Tried moving round morning some flammable material

annotationWithheld.why: Tried moving round morning some flammable material (6): an anagram of TRIED gives five letters; nothing in 'morning some' plainly supplies the N needed for TINDER, so the clue looks misread or garbled.
annotationWithheld.clue: Tried moving round morning some flammable material

clue.text: Nothing put inside sailor's instrument is complete

indicators.note: put inside means the zero goes between the sailor's and the instrument

parts.note: AB is an able seaman, so AB's
the lute is a plucked stringed instrument
O is zero, nothing

explanation.surface: A seaman's musical instrument has nothing stuffed in it, so it is whole.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sailor's instrument' reads as one object, but splits into the able seaman's possessive and the lute.
explanation.definitionFit: Total, unqualified and utter, as in an absolute disaster.

clue.text: Stop functioning sideways

parts.note: to end is to stop
on means working, as a machine switched on

explanation.surface: Someone stops working while lying on their side.
explanation.definitionFit: Facing with the narrow tip forward rather than the broad face is the edge-first position.

clue.text: Traps I am setting to get meat

indicators.note: setting means arranging these letters into a new order

explanation.surface: A hunter sets snares to catch meat.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a spiced smoked beef, popular in delicatessen sandwiches.

clue.text: Edward contained a horse that worried constantly

indicators.note: contained means the pet name for Edward holds the rest inside it

parts.note: Ned is a short form of Edward
gee-gee, GG, is a childish word for a horse

explanation.surface: A man called Edward kept a horse that fretted all the time.
explanation.walkthrough: The pet name Ned, not the usual Ed, is the Edward needed here.
explanation.definitionFit: Harassed or pestered continually, as with endless complaints.

clue.text: It's plain a French dart was thrown about

indicators.note: about means the jumbled dart surrounds the French article
was thrown means the letters of dart are tossed into a new order

parts.note: un is French for a

explanation.surface: A Frenchman's dart flew wide across open country.
explanation.walkthrough: 'was thrown' turns the dart into TDRA; 'It's plain' points to the noun plain, a wide flat landscape.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a vast treeless Arctic plain with frozen subsoil.

clue.text: Not into a rambling system of signs

indicators.note: rambling means these letters wander into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone declines to go on a ramble.
explanation.definitionFit: A set of symbols used to record music or mathematics is a written code.
